content:
[0] WhatsApp today announced several new features on its official blog, including the ability to share Apple Music and Spotify listening activity to WhatsApp Status, account setup features for iPad, and other updates.

[1] WhatsApp announces support for Apple Music sharing, direct account setup on iPad, and other new features

[2] In addition to launching the Adobe Acrobat PDF integration today, WhatsApp also announced several recently added features.

[3] One of the new features lets you share your Apple Music or Spotify listening activity directly to your WhatsApp Status. The blog post states:

[4] We first discovered this feature was in development back in November last year, and WhatsApp says it has now officially launched.

[5] Another new change is that iPad users can now set up a WhatsApp account directly on their iPad, without needing to sign in with a phone number. According to today's announcement, since the launch of the WhatsApp iPad app, this has been a popular request from users.

[6] Finally, the WhatsApp article also highlighted the recently upgraded CarPlay version of the app, which now lets users do much more than before.

[7] Of all the new WhatsApp features above, which one are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
